summary.text: Betrayers of Kamigawa takes place on Kamigawa, as the Kami War and a spirit beast threaten the world, and it follows Toshi Umezawa, who is in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach.
Toshi persuades Hidetsugu to attack Jukai before razing Minamo and Otawara, and later the spirit beast O-Kagachi descends on Eiganjo Castle, rips Yosei in half and ruins the castle.
Toshi teleports into Konda's sanctum and steals the Taken One during the chaos, so O-Kagachi senses its absence and retreats, leaving Konda's kingdom in ruins.
